page.title: Gateway Mode
page.description: Use this computer as a transparent LAN gateway and let mihomo route and account for downstream traffic.
page.clientHelp: Configure clients manually, or enable DHCP Server on an isolated downstream network to distribute network settings automatically.
page.selectInterfaceError: Select a LAN interface with an IPv4 address
page.dhcpDescription: Assign downstream IP addresses and distribute gateway, DNS and lease settings.
page.dhcpWarning: Only one DHCP server may run on a subnet. Use a dedicated port/VLAN or disable the existing downstream DHCP server to avoid network disruption.
page.fixedIpHelp: DHCP will always assign this address to the device MAC. Reconnect the device network to apply it immediately.
page.deviceNeedsMac: A detected MAC address is required to save device settings
page.fixedIpSubnetError: The fixed IP must be in the DHCP subnet and must not equal the gateway address
page.fixedIpDuplicateError: This fixed IP is already assigned to another device
page.reconnectForFixedIp: Fixed IP saved. Reconnect the device network or replug its cable to obtain the new address
page.internetPaused: Internet access paused for this device
page.internetResumed: Internet access restored for this device
page.blockedDomainsHelp: Applies only to this device and blocks the domain and its subdomains.
page.blockedPortsHelp: Comma-separated, for example 25, 135, 139, 445. Useful for restricting unnecessary or unsafe services.
page.deviceNotesHelp: Record location, model, purpose, or owner. Stored only on this Mac.
page.invalidPorts: Ports must be integers between 1 and 65535
page.invalidDomains: Invalid domain format. Enter one ordinary domain per line
